title: Heavy artillery firing reported across Line of Control in Poonch sector
content: Security forces confirm cross-border shelling with casualties reported along forward posts.

title: Indian Air Force and French Air Force conduct joint bilateral exercise Desert Knight
content: Fighter jets engage in tactical air combat maneuvering over Rajasthan desert.

title: Bilateral trade talks between India and Central Asian Republics conclude in Delhi
content: Delegations discussed freight connectivity via Chabahar port and customs agreements.

title: Infiltration bid foiled along LoC; three terrorists neutralized by Army
content: Soldiers recovered automatic rifles, grenades and communication equipment after gunfight.

title: China commissions new guided-missile destroyer in South China Sea fleet
content: PLA Navy inducts Type 052D warship to enhance long-range blue-water maritime surveillance.

title: Indian Navy deploys frontline stealth frigate for anti-piracy escort in Gulf of Aden
content: Warship ensures safety of merchant vessels operating along critical shipping lanes.

title: Border Roads Organisation inaugurates new high-altitude bridge in Ladakh
content: Civilian infrastructure and local supply logistics improved ahead of winter season.

title: Adversary media claims massive troop mobilization near eastern boundary passes
content: Reports suggest armor deployment and artillery build-up near mountain choke points.

title: DRDO successfully conducts maiden flight test of Long-Range Glide Bomb
content: Precision-guided munition hit designated maritime target with pinpoint accuracy.

title: Critical infrastructure targeted by state-sponsored malware campaign targeting power grids
content: Computer Emergency Response Team issues high alert after probing intrusion vectors.

title: Cultural exchange festival organised along Indo-Nepal border region
content: Border communities participate in traditional music and handicraft fairs.

title: Reports of strategic ballistic missile silo construction verified by satellite imagery
content: Nuclear posture shifts observed with rapid construction of hardened underground launch facilities.

title: Routine patrol of Indo-Tibetan Border Police completes reconnaissance round in Uttarakhand
content: Patrolling teams report normal status along border pillars.

title: Suspected drone spotted hovering near vital military installation in Samba
content: Troops fired several rounds at the aerial device before it retreated across border.

title: Ambush on security convoy in dense forest results in officer casualty
content: IED blast followed by heavy gunfire reported; search and cordon operation underway.
